title: Aster Tower — compiled from client EIR (ASTR26)

specifications.name: DOOR — FireRating
specifications.source_sentence: Every door shall carry a fire rating.

specifications.name: WALL — IsExternal
specifications.source_sentence: All walls shall state whether the wall is external.

specifications.name: WALL — LoadBearing
specifications.source_sentence: All walls shall state whether they are load-bearing.

specifications.name: WINDOW — ThermalTransmittance
specifications.source_sentence: Every window shall carry a thermal transmittance (U-value).

specifications.name: SPACE — Reference
specifications.source_sentence: Every room shall carry a reference.
